context: Two cafe friends realize how fast a season slipped by
purpose: Teach: いつのまにか/とどめ/解り/なおさら/気付く/且つ/はかる/躊躇

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いつのまにか春が終わってたね。窓の外見て、毎年ふと気付くんだよね。
lines.en: Spring slipped by before I knew it. Every year, looking out the window, I just suddenly notice.
lines.style: Soft observational tone with a gentle mid-sentence pause, slightly wistful

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ほんとに。桜が散ったあの日が、春にとどめを刺した感じだったなあ。
lines.en: Really. The day the cherry blossoms fell felt like the final blow to spring.
lines.style: Dreamy and leaning forward, voice trailing romantically toward the end

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 解り合えるなあ。忙しい時って、季節の変わり目になおさら鈍くなるよね。
lines.en: We really get each other. When you're busy, you get even duller to the seasons changing.
lines.style: Sympathetic calm barista voice with a light understanding sigh

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私、来るタイミングをはかるのが下手で、気がつけば夏になってた。
lines.en: I'm bad at gauging when to come, and before I noticed, it was summer.
lines.style: Slightly embarrassed laugh with playful self-blame in her voice

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 躊躇しすぎだよ、二人とも。今年の春は静かで、あっという間だったね。
lines.en: We both hesitate too much. This spring was quiet and over in a flash.
lines.style: Warm chuckle while shaking his head and wiping a coffee cup

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ね。半年経ってるの、シンプル且つ確実に怖いんだけど。
lines.en: Right. Half a year having passed is simply and surely terrifying.
lines.style: Quieter and almost whispering, hands wrapped around her warm cup

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: じゃあ夏はもう躊躇しないで、こまめに来てよ。アイスコーヒー始めたから。
lines.en: Then don't hesitate this summer, come by often. I started serving iced coffee.
lines.style: Bright friendly invitation with a grin while sliding the menu over
